title: ResearchGate profile research-item count on 12 August 2026

source.rights_status: reference capture; not redistributed in this record

observation.direct_description: The supplied live profile screenshot visibly displays '75 Research items'.
observation.exact_feature_location: Profile metrics row beneath the ResearchGate profile header

inherited_designation: Public web/search indexes observed during the same archive pass returned lower publication counts.
alternatives: The first-party screenshot is stale rather than the search index.
ResearchGate counts different object classes in different interfaces.
controls: A preserved March 2026 ResearchGate profile snapshot lists 63 items, demonstrating that the corpus count changes over time rather than remaining fixed.
failure_conditions: The screenshot is shown not to be the Sean Diamond profile.
The visible number is shown to refer to a different metric than Research items.
A more direct first-party record from the same date establishes a different count and explains the discrepancy.
correction_lineage: An initial archive note treated a public search-index count as current. The user supplied the live first-party profile screenshot, and the archive corrected the controlling count to 75 rather than silently retaining or averaging the derivative count.
